Subject: Staggered RSVP reminders + suppression window for Aug 31 webcast

Team —

Quick plan for the Aug 31 webcast ("Scaling Inference: Cost, Latency, and Rollouts"). Goal: maximize live attendance from mid-market platform engineers while minimizing reminder fatigue and duplicate sends to people who already clicked or RSVP'ed. Draft timeline below — please flag issues.

1) Initial invite (sent today) — generic invite to full list.
2) Reminder A — 48 hours before event (Aug 29 10:00 PDT) — to non-openers only.
3) Reminder B — 24 hours before event (Aug 30 10:00 PDT) — all non-RSVPs.
4) Day-of reminder — 3 hours before (Aug 31 08:00 PDT) — registered + last-chance CTA for recently-opened non-RSVPs.

Suppression & snooze rules (critical):
- Click suppression: if recipient clicks any registration link, suppress reminders for 14 days (to avoid follow-ups on re-clicks).
- RSVP suppression: if user registers via form, remove from all later reminders immediately.
- Engagement snooze: if a recipient opened the invite but did not click, we still suppress the 48h but keep them for 24h reminder. This reduces repeats for casual opens.

Segmentation:
- "Platform Eng" cohort (behavioral + title filters): make copy more technical, include latency/cost bullets and a link to the benchmark deck.
- "PM/Procurement" cohort: copy emphasizing SLA, pricing, and enterprise capabilities.

Tracking and experiment keys: we need distinct UTMs for: cohort, channel (email), variant (copy A/B), and experiment slug. Marissa — can you confirm HubSpot workflow IDs and HubSpot list IDs? Karthik — can you confirm the blast suppression window mapping to our ESP (we use SendGrid + HubSpot for send orchestration)?

Assets attached: invite-banner-v3.png, draft copy (in Drive link). I'll attach final UTM mapping once we've aligned.

Ask: please review and reply with any blocking concerns by EOD. If no replies, I'll push the initial send at 11:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
